notes: 6 ¶ Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man [is] a friend to him that giveth gifts.
Defers his anger A conflict can be better resolved after a cooling-off time. We can pass over or ignore an offense if we remember that the Lord is our shepherd.
Proverbs 19:23 23 ¶ The fear of the LORD [tendeth] to life: and [he that hath it] shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
